description: Transporte Hidroviário - Eclusas e Portos is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Construção de eclusas e implantação de portos. Empreendimento pertencente a carteira do Anexo III do PPA 2012-2015. Programa 2073. Iniciativas 00QB e 00W4 - escala 1:1.100.000. Sistema de referência: SIRGAS2000. Coverage: Brasil. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
